entities.summary: The Diocese of Sandakan is a Latin Catholic ecclesiastical jurisdiction located in Sabah, at East Malaysia. It is a suffragan diocese of the Archdiocese of Kota Kinabalu. The diocese is subdivided into 5 parishes and 1 mission district (Paitan), covering the east coast portion of the state comprising the Sandakan as well as Tawau divisions.
